title: Homogenization of Lévy-type operators: operator estimates with correctors
summary: The goal of the paper is to study in $L_2(\R^d)$ a self-adjoint operator ${\mathbb A}_\eps$, $\eps >0$, of the form $$ ({\mathbb A}_\eps u) (\x) = \int_{\R^d} μ(\x/\eps, \y/\eps) \frac{\left( u(\x) - u(\y) \right)}{|\x - \y|^{d+α}}\,d\y $$ with $1< α< 2$; here the function $μ(\x,\y)$ is $\Z^d$-periodic in the both variables, satisfies the symmetry relation $μ(\x,\y) = μ(\y,\x)$ and the estimates $0< μ_- \leqslant μ(\x,\y) \leqslant μ_+< \infty$. The rigorous definition of the operator ${\mathbb A}_\eps$ is given in terms of the corresponding quadratic form. In the previous work of the…
